FULL TEXT:
Corrigendum to Advertisement No. 2/2025
The last date for submitting online Applications for the posts of Assistant
Professor and Associate Professor in various subjects in the P.U.
Departments / Institutes/ Centres is extended upto 28.08.2025. Further, the
last date for submitting hard copies of online application along with supporting
documents in the office of the Deputy Registrar (Estt.), Panjab University,
Chandigarh is also extended up to 04.09.2025 up to 4:00 P.M.
Note: (i)Only one application form is required for the following posts of
Assistant professor in Law in Panjab University Regional Centre
Ludhiana:
L.L.B. 3 YEARS Course-2
5 YEARS B.A. L.L.B-1
(ii) Separate application form is required for the 1-post of Assistant
professor in Law (LLM) (SC) in Panjab University Regional Centre
Ludhiana
-sd/-
Registrar
